data.name: Gulzarilal
data.gender_notes: Gulzarilal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who enjoys and cherishes the beauty and fragrance of flowers. In Hindu mythology, Gulzarilal is a name for Lord Krishna, who is often depicted playing the flute, which represents the essence of love. The name Gulzarilal carries the meaning “Lover of flowers” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gulzarilal usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies love and beauty, inspiring devotion and appreciation for the world around us.
data.etymology: Gulzarilal belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of flowers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gulzarilal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
